chosenContractBeforeProduction.decision: Ordinary upstream ACK routing remains default. Existing start_path_probe/start_probe explicitly opts only its current local path binding into own-path Backup ACK routing; new/migrated bindings start ordinary. Each peer must opt in locally for two-way blackhole backup proof. No ordinary ping or unrelated path opts in. Preserve current frame and packet gates, authenticated watermark and close handling.
chosenContractBeforeProduction.basis: Repeated real unchanged original/fork consumer shows 1ms vs253ms slow Backup data confirmation; actual one-packet loss 29ms vs532ms. Therefore unconditional policy is not a universal defect fix under ADR0012.
chosenContractBeforeProduction.knownUnchangedBoundary: Stale Available carrier blackhole can still prevent ordinary close delivery; recover/retire it first. ACK opt-in is not close routing or automatic migration. Existing maintained close/retirement scenarios remain mandatory.
